whiteVerdict.headline: Stop playing Mainline Open Sicilian (52 losses!). Switch 100% to your 68.8% Alapin (c3) weapon.

pursueList.name: Sicilian: Alapin (1.e4 c5 2.c3)
pursueList.reason: You score 68.8% vs 2446 average opponents. Complete control of center with early d4, avoiding 50 pages of complex Sicilian theory.
pursueList.studyPlan: Master the 2...d5 3.exd5 Qxd5 4.d4 lines and the IQP (Isolated Queen's Pawn) attack with Bd3 + O-O + Re1.

pursueList.name: Italian: Giuoco Piano (c3 + d3/d4)
pursueList.reason: Solid 55.6% win rate against 2400s. You understand the quiet Italian setup much better than the Two Knights.
pursueList.studyPlan: Study standard plans with Nbd2, Re1, h3, and Nf1-g3 kingside knight transfer.

pursueList.name: Scandinavian & Alekhine Punishers
pursueList.reason: Over 64% win rate when opponents play off-beat 1.e4 defenses.
pursueList.studyPlan: Continue active central occupation and rapid piece development.

ditchList.name: Open Sicilian (Main Lines)
ditchList.danger: You suffered 52 losses in 93 games! 2400-level Black players out-calculate you in sharp Dragon/Najdorf lines.

ditchList.name: French: Exchange Variation (3.exd5)
ditchList.danger: 32.4% win rate! Exchanging pawns on d5 surrenders White's initiative. Black easily develops the c8 bishop and counter-attacks.
ditchList.alternative: Switch to 3.e5 (Advance Variation) or 3.Nc3 (Classical/Winawer) for active piece play.

ditchList.name: Italian: Two Knights (3...Nf6)
ditchList.danger: 16 losses in 25 games. Tactical complications after 4.Ng5 or 4.d4 are backfiring.
ditchList.alternative: Play 4.d3 (Giuoco Pianissimo) and avoid sharp pawn sacrifices.

blackVerdict.headline: The 1.d4 Black Emergency: Stop playing the Benoni (28.6% win rate). Pick a solid classical center.

pursueList.name: Philidor Defense (1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 d6)
pursueList.reason: Your most tested weapon with 157 games and 76 wins against 2388 avg opponents. Reliable and solid.
pursueList.studyPlan: Refine move orders against 3.d4 exd4 4.Nxd4 Nf6 and practice the Hanham variation (Nbd7, Be7, c6, O-O, Re8).

ditchList.name: Benoni Defense (1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 c5 3.d5)
ditchList.danger: 28.6% win rate! The weak d6 pawn and lack of central space give 2400s an easy queenside/kingside clamp.
ditchList.alternative: Do NOT play modern Benoni in competitive games.

ditchList.name: Loose Indian & Queen Pawn Setups
ditchList.danger: Over 65 games with sub-35% win rate. When opponents play 1.d4 or 1.Nf3, your repertoire collapses.
ditchList.alternative: Adopt either King's Indian Defense (KID) with aggressive ...e5, or solid Queen's Gambit Declined (QGD).

ditchList.name: English Opening: Hedgehog (c5/e6/d6)
ditchList.danger: Hedgehog requires deep positional patience. At blitz/rapid, cramped positions invite fast White pawn storms.
ditchList.alternative: Play 1...e5 (Reversed Sicilian) against 1.c4 for open, active piece play.

studyModules.title: 1. Master the Alapin (c3) Repertoire
studyModules.description: You already score 68.8% here. Turn it into your deadliest 1.e4 weapon.
keyThemes: When Black plays 2...d5: 3.exd5 Qxd5 4.d4 Nf6 5.Nf3 Bg4 6.Be2
When Black plays 2...Nf6: 3.e5 Nd5 4.d4 cxd4 5.Nf3 Nc6 6.Bc4
Handling the Isolated Queen's Pawn (IQP) on d4 with active piece play

studyModules.title: 2. The 1.d4 Emergency: Switch to King's Indian or QGD
studyModules.description: Your win rate drops below 30% against 1.d4. You need an active, reliable shield.
keyThemes: King's Indian Defense (KID): 1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 g6 3.Nc3 Bg7 4.e4 d6 5.Nf3 O-O 6.Be2 e5!
Mar del Plata plan: Lock the center with ...e5-e4, launch kingside pawn storm with ...f5-f4, ...g5, ...h5
Queen's Gambit Declined (QGD): Carlsbad structure defense, minority attack counterplay

studyModules.title: 3. Fix the French: Replace 3.exd5 with 3.e5 Advance
studyModules.description: French Exchange (3.exd5) gives you only 32.4% win rate. Stop trading pawns.
keyThemes: Lock the center, restrict Black's c8 bishop ('the French bishop')
Kingside attacking plans with h4, Bd3, and O-O

studyModules.title: 4. Sharpen the Philidor Hanham Setup
studyModules.description: Your go-to 1.e4 weapon with 157 games. Make it invincible.
keyThemes: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 d6 3.d4 Nd7! (avoiding early Queen trade)
Counter-strike with ...a6 and ...b5 on the queenside
